source: Adapted from the published 2.7.0 lib/index.js bundle. The v2.7.0 release tag and registry gitHead identify the archived upstream tests; its internal package version remains 2.6.7.

dependencies.whatwg-url: Removed: native node:url on supported runtimes
dependencies.encoding: Legacy optional textConverted uses viconv-lite lazily

changes: Validate sizes, deadlines and redirect counts; enforce size on direct buffers as well as streams.
Reject premature close, clear body listeners/timers and propagate cancellation/limits through response pipelines.
Copy emitted chunks to preserve bytes when producers reuse buffers.
Strip sensitive headers on any cross-origin redirect, including port changes.
Include pool queue time in the request deadline; JSON parse errors omit response contents.
Use native absolute URL conversion while retaining relative Request construction.
Preserve native Blob bytes, upload failures, immediate abort errors and HTTP keep-alive reuse.
